Playwright A11y Tree vs. Pure Pixel VLM vs. OmniParser v2 Set-of-Mark (SoM)

Why Pure DOM (Tier 1/3) & Pure VLM (Tier 2) Struggle

• Tier 2 (Pure Pixel VLM): Guessing (x, y) on 1920x1080 misses tiny
12x12px icons (68.4% success) and takes 1,850 ms per click
• Tier 3 (A11y Tree): Blind to <canvas>, unlabelled SVG icons & Citrix
Tier 4: Hybrid A11y + OmniParser v2 SoM + Batch
